$comment: The MCP servers of the end-to-end run. runner/prepare-profile.ts writes the 'mcp' entries into the user-level mcp.json, runner/start-servers.ts starts the 'process' entries inside the test container (a 'command' with its 'port'; in front of it, or of 'upstreamPort' for an entry without a command: runner/grpc-log-proxy.ts for 'grpcLogProxy', runner/http-fault-proxy.ts for 'httpProxy', runner/oauth-fixture.ts for 'oauthFixture'), and the suite reads the expectations. {zig} and {everything} are replaced with the zig-sdk conformance server and the server-everything entry point, {tlsCa} with the CA certificate runner/test-ca.ts generates at run time. 'expectConnectError' marks a negative entry (VS Code must fail to connect; 'sharesProcessOf' names the entry whose process and logs it uses), 'ownTest' an entry that only its own test starts, 'suite': 'ui' one that only the UI suite starts (its sign-in needs a dialog answered), 'provider' one that the E2E extension defines through the API instead of mcp.json.

process.$comment: runner/http-fault-proxy.ts on 3000 (no faults) records every request VS Code sends to this server (HTTP method and the MCP headers) in servers/zig-http.http.jsonl and applies the HTTP mutations of runner/mutations.ts; the zig-sdk server listens on 3010.
VS Code connects to runner/grpc-log-proxy.ts on 50052, which forwards to the server on 50062 and records every call in servers/zig-grpc-typed.wire.jsonl (the server logs no requests).
No protocolVersion: VS Code probes with server/discover over HTTP, the 2025-11-25 server refuses it (400 without a session), and VS Code falls back to initialize.
The legacy HTTP+SSE transport of server-everything: the Streamable HTTP probe fails, VS Code falls back to the SSE GET.

runner/http-fault-proxy.ts on 3111 in front of the zig-http server (3010) injects the 2026-07-28 error paths for named tools: -32021 (test_audio_content), an unknown resultType (test_embedded_resource), an outputSchema mismatch (test_simple_text) and match (greet), -32022 naming the revision in use (test_image_content), and tools/list split by an empty-string nextCursor.

runner/http-fault-proxy.ts on 3113: the first tools/call of greet gets -32022 offering only 2025-11-25, then the proxy serves the 2025-11-25 handshake itself and bridges the retried call to the zig-http server (3010). Started by its own test: the switch to 2025-11-25 lasts for the rest of the connection.

servers.label: zig-http-pin-legacy
servers.$comment: The zig-http server (2026-07-28 only) pinned to 2025-11-25 in mcp.json. The protocolVersion setting documents that a pinned revision the server rejects still falls back to negotiation; its own test asserts that (initialize first, then server/discover and 2026-07-28).

process.$comment: The server of the gateway listen-stream test (its tool list is toggled there).

The conformance server with --apps: it declares the MCP Apps extension (io.modelcontextprotocol/ui) and serves its fixture, the view ui://conformance/view (text/html;profile=mcp-app) and test_app_tool, whose _meta.ui.resourceUri names it (listed so only to a client that declares the extension, as VS Code does).

runner/grpc-log-proxy.ts on 50053 answers the JSON-RPC tunnel with a bare UNIMPLEMENTED (as a typed-only gRPC server does) and forwards the typed service to the server on 50063. binding auto speaks only the tunnel: VS Code must fail to connect, name "binding": "typed" as the fix, and send no typed RPC (which would succeed here).

runner/grpc-log-proxy.ts terminates TLS on 50056 (server certificate for localhost from the run's throw-away CA) and forwards cleartext to the server on 50066. binding is left at its default (auto: the tunnel answers).

servers.label: zig-grpcs-sni
servers.$comment: An IP URL with tls.serverName localhost: the handshake must use that SNI and verify the certificate for localhost.

servers.label: zig-grpcs-insecure
servers.$comment: No tls.ca but tls.insecure: VS Code connects without verifying the certificate and logs the warning.

process.$comment: The soak test's own server: about 1,200 calls on one HTTP/2 session through runner/grpc-log-proxy.ts on 50055, a Node http2 server. Its rapid-reset protection (nghttp2: a bucket of 1000 resets refilled at 33/s) runs without the refill here: a client that resets completed streams loses the session after 1000 calls however slowly they come.

runner/grpc-log-proxy.ts on 50058 in front of the zig-grpc-tunnel server rewrites the mirrored mcp-name metadata of the first tools/call of greet (once) and of every tools/call of test_simple_text (always), so the server answers -32020 in the trailers.

runner/grpc-log-proxy.ts on 50059 in front of the zig-grpc-tunnel server holds every tools/call of greet for 5 s; deadlineMs 1500 makes VS Code give up after 1.5 s (the cancellation test cancels it earlier).

runner/oauth-fixture.ts: the protected resource on 3400 (its PRM at a custom path that only the challenge names), the authorization server on its own origin 3410 with the path issuer /tenant; authorized requests go to the /mcp of the server on 3107.
runner/oauth-fixture.ts --iss-mode wrong: the authorization response carries an iss that is not the issuer; the sign-in must fail before the token request.
runner/oauth-fixture.ts --iss-mode omit: no iss although the metadata announces authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported; the sign-in must fail before the token request.

runner/oauth-fixture.ts with its gRPC front on 50060 (UNAUTHENTICATED with www-authenticate without a token) in front of the zig-grpc-tunnel server; PRM and authorization server on 3404 (resource https://127.0.0.1:50060/).

provider.$comment: Not in mcp.json: the E2E extension returns it from its McpServerDefinitionProvider as a vscode.McpGrpcServerDefinition (binding Auto), through runner/grpc-log-proxy.ts on 50057 in front of the zig-grpc-tunnel server.

process.$comment: Only the proxy (the zig-grpc-tunnel server is the upstream).

provider.$comment: An API definition with McpGrpcBinding.Typed against the zig-grpc-typed proxy.
An API definition over TLS (tls.ca: the run's CA from MCP_E2E_TLS_DIR) against the zig-grpcs TLS proxy.
